findings_addressed.oracle: Path-join semantics / resource-existence spec: an empty resource path is not a real resource; pathlib `Path(assets_dir) / ""` equals `assets_dir` itself (verified via pathlib), so the empty path is NOT a distinct asset and resource_exists("") must be False. The expected value (False) is derived independently from path semantics, not from data the test injected.

falsifiability.mutation: exists = path.exists() ->         exists = bool(resource_path) and path.exists()

production_defects.expected: resource_exists("") returns False — an empty path is not an existing resource
production_defects.actual: resource_exists("") returns True because get_resource_path("") normalizes the empty string to "" and `assets_dir / ""` evaluates to the assets directory itself (which exists), so path.exists() is True
